widgets_values:
<Picture 1>: IDENTITY reference for the man replacing the original model. Preserve his facial identity, dark swept hair, salt-and-pepper beard, and his wardrobe — light oatmeal crewneck sweater, dark blue slim jeans, brown leather shoes.


SCENE / FRAMING:
A high-key studio fashion presentation of a single man (the identity from <Picture 1>) against seamless backdrops. Setups progress: left-profile standing on white with a horizontal black "DXXXKONAY" white-text banner; front-facing on white; a four-up lineup of the same man in varied poses on a grey backdrop; an arm-raised-behind-head close-up; a dual composition with a seated duplicate on a black leather couch; and a final seated-low pose with knees up in front of a large black circle on white.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values: Create a product photograph of a perfume bottle packshot based on the geometric arrangement in the first image, replacing the plain white block and spheres with a cream-colored tabletop and a refined glass perfume bottle. Preserve the central upright silhouette: a tall rectangular bottle with softly rounded shoulders, a broad clear-glass body, and a short rectangular gold cap, now rendered as a transparent bottle filled with pale amber perfume and surrounded by a polished gold collar. Place it centrally on the cream table, with warm golden refracted light passing through the glass and casting amber highlights and soft-edged shadows. Replace the two white spheres with a small arrangement of ripe fruit: a red apple at frame-left, a yellow lemon and a cluster of purple grapes near the bottle base, and a green pear at frame-right. Add fresh eucalyptus leaves and small glossy green leaves around the fruit, echoing the original spheres’ positions without covering the bottle. Use a warm key light from above and frame-left, with a narrow golden rim light along the bottle’s right edge. Keep the background as a seamless cream-to-beige gradient, with subtle reflections beneath the bottle and natural contact shadows grounding every object.
